# fco_project (Resource)

Manages a project on the fits.cloud platform.

Projects belong to the tenant the provider is configured with.  Use them to group resources and permissions.
 Can be imported by UUID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manage a project within the tenant the provider is configured with.
resource "fco_project" "my_project" {
  name        = "my-project"
  description = "Managed by Terraform"

  labels = {
    env  = "dev"
    team = "platform"
  }
}

output "project_uuid" {
  value = fco_project.my_project.uuid
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) A free-text description of the project.
- `name` (String) The name of the project.The name is immutable; changing it destroys and recreates the project.

### Optional

- `labels` (Map of String) A set of key/value label pairs assigned to the resource.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The timestamp (RFC 3339) when the project was created.
- `tenant` (String) The tenant the project belongs to.
- `updated_at` (String) Server-side last-modified timestamp (RFC 3339). Managed automatically for optimistic locking.
- `uuid` (String) The unique identifier (UUID) of the project.
